[[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]]4 (Explosion) |speed = 2 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ripped Elf''' is one of the final [[units]] that spawns from the [[Elf Camp]]. It spawns when the [[Elf Camp]] is at Level 4. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. It has a spawnrate of 100 seconds. Whenever there are enemies in its range, the '''Ripped Elf''' will stop moving and attack the enemies. It will throw a large snow boulder at the enemies, which deals [[Splash Damage]] in a large area. ==Appearance== The '''Ripped Elf''' has tan skin and a white beard. It wears a green sleeveless shirt with white stripes, dark green pants, brown belt and red shoes. It has muscular arms, with which it picks up large snowballs from the ground. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:RippedElf.png|175px]] |[[File:ChocolatierRippedElf.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} |{{Color|Valentines2026|Chocolatier}} |- !Obtained From |[[Christmas 2025 Crate]] |[[Valentines 2026 Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Ripped Elf's''' high splash damage makes it quite useful against hordes of enemies that appear later on during the game. **Its high health and range also allows it to survive much longer than most other [[Elf Camp]] units. *On multi-pathed maps, only one '''Ripped Elf''' will spawn per Level 4 [[Elf Camp]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Ripped Elf''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Living Experiment]] or [[Elite Hazmat]]. *The '''Ripped Elf''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. ==Trivia== *The {{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} skin is based on the [[Ripped Elf (Cold Ambush)|Ripped Elf]] enemy from [[Cold Ambush]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''21 December 2022''' -
